title: Two-door wardrobe

options.name: The design
options.text: A fitted wardrobe filling the space, with two flat doors and wooden knobs. Inside, a shelf at the top over a hanging rail, and a low shelf for shoes.

poster.alt: 3D model of a two-door wardrobe with a top shelf, a hanging rail and a shoe shelf inside

notes: Width, height and depth are the sizes of the space as measured.
The inside layout is a standard one to start from: shelves and the rail can go wherever suits you.
Made from 18 mm board, backs included, on a plinth set back from the doors.
Colours on screen are a guide.
